nodes.description: address owner of the Usdcoins token contract; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
constant public string name = "USDC".
constant public string symbol = "USDC".
constant public uint256 decimals = 18.
constant public uint256 totalSupply = 100000000e18, minted to deployer at construction.
constant private MAX_UINT256 sentinel used to skip allowance decrease for unlimited approvals.
public mapping(address => uint256) balanceOf holding token balances; mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed holding ERC20 allowances; written by approve, read and reduced by transferFrom/allowance.
uint public raisedAmount, cumulative ETH raised by the ICO contract.
uint256 public RATE = 400, tokens per wei; mutable through setRate by the owner.
bool public icostart = true, sale-active flag checked by the whenSaleIsActive modifier and toggled by setIcostart.
address owner of the icocontract, set to msg.sender at construction; source of tokens and ETH recipient.
Usdcoins public token, the ERC20 contract instance sold by the ICO; set by setToken and used in buyTokens.
SafeMathMod.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) constant internal; multiplies and asserts consistency against overflow.
SafeMathMod.div(uint256 a, uint256 b) constant internal; asserts non-zero divisor and result consistency.
SafeMathMod.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure; requires the subtraction result to be strictly smaller than a (underflow guard).
SafeMathMod.add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure; requires the addition result to be strictly larger than a (overflow guard).
Usdcoins anonymous payable fallback that immediately reverts all direct ETH transfers.
Usdcoins constructor: assigns totalSupply to msg.sender balance and sets owner = msg.sender.
Usdcoins modifier onlyOwner, requires msg.sender == owner (defined but unused in this contract).
ERC20 transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): moves tokens from msg.sender to _to using SafeMathMod.
ERC20 transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): allowance-checked transfer using SafeMathMod and MAX_UINT256 gas optimisation.
multiPartyTransfer(address[] _toAddresses, uint256[] _amounts): loops (uint8 i) calling transfer for each pair, limited to 255 entries.
multiPartyTransferFrom(address _from, address[] _toAddresses, uint256[] _amounts): loops calling transferFrom for each pair.
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval.
allowance(address _owner, address _spender) view: returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
isNotContract(address _addr) private view: uses inline assembly extcodesize to test whether an address is a contract (unused).
icocontract constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
icocontract modifier whenSaleIsActive, requires icostart == true before executing the body.
icocontract modifier onlyOwner, requires msg.sender == owner; guards setToken/setRate/setIcostart.
setToken(Usdcoins _token) onlyOwner: assigns the sold token contract.
setRate(uint256 rate) onlyOwner: updates RATE.
setIcostart(bool newicostart) onlyOwner: toggles the sale-active flag.
icocontract external payable fallback that forwards to buyTokens().
buyTokens() payable whenSaleIsActive: computes tokens = msg.value * RATE, adds msg.value to raisedAmount, calls token.transferFrom(owner, msg.sender, tokens) then owner.transfer(msg.value).
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance/allowance indexing and token recipient.
balanceOf[msg.sender].sub(_value) inside transfer: unchecked-by-caller arithmetic decrement relying on SafeMathMod underflow assertion.
balanceOf[_to].add(_value) inside transfer: SafeMathMod overflow-guarded balance increment.
balanceOf[_from].sub(_value) inside transferFrom: decrements the source balance under underflow guard.
balanceOf[_to].add(_value) inside transferFrom: increments the destination balance.
allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) inside transferFrom: conditional allowance decrement unless MAX_UINT256 or self-transfer.
weiAmount.mul(RATE) inside buyTokens: token amount computation using SafeMathMod.mul.
raisedAmount.add(msg.value) inside buyTokens: cumulative ETH accounting.
owner.transfer(msg.value) inside buyTokens: external ETH value call executed after state changes.
token.transferFrom(owner, msg.sender, tokens) inside buyTokens: external call into the token contract during a payable state-changing function.

Parameter b of SafeMathMod.mul.
Local c = a * b in SafeMathMod.mul.
Parameter a of SafeMathMod.div.
Parameter b of SafeMathMod.div.
Local c = a / b in SafeMathMod.div.

Named return value c = a - b in SafeMathMod.sub.
Parameter a of SafeMathMod.add.
Parameter b of SafeMathMod.add.
Named return value c = a + b in SafeMathMod.add.
Parameter _to (recipient) of transfer.
Parameter _value (amount) of transfer.
Named return bool success of transfer.
Parameter _from (source) of transferFrom.
Parameter _to (recipient) of transferFrom.
Parameter _value (amount) of transferFrom.
Local uint256 allowance = allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
Named return bool success of transferFrom.
Parameter _toAddresses array of multiPartyTransfer.
Parameter _amounts array of multiPartyTransfer.
Loop counter uint8 i in multiPartyTransfer.
Parameter _from of multiPartyTransferFrom.
Parameter _toAddresses array of multiPartyTransferFrom.
Parameter _amounts array of multiPartyTransferFrom.
Loop counter uint8 i in multiPartyTransferFrom.
Parameter _spender of approve.
Parameter _value of approve.
Named return bool success of approve.
Parameter _owner of allowance.
Parameter _spender of allowance.
Named return uint256 remaining of allowance.
Parameter _addr of isNotContract.
Local uint length filled from extcodesize(_addr) in isNotContract.
Parameter _token of setToken (Usdcoins instance to be sold).
Parameter rate of setRate.
Parameter newicostart of setIcostart.
Local uint256 weiAmount = msg.value in buyTokens.
Local uint256 tokens = weiAmount.mul(RATE) in buyTokens.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the key into the balanceOf mapping in the constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
msg.sender is the first key of the allowed mapping in approve and transferFrom, so a caller controls which allowance entry is touched.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner, gating privileged execution.
The icocontract onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender == owner, gating admin functions.
The constructor mints totalSupply to msg.sender and stores msg.sender as owner.
transfer debits balanceOf[msg.sender], so the caller's identity determines the funded account.
transferFrom reads allowed[_from][msg.sender] and allows spending when _from == msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller as allowance owner.
buyTokens sends purchased tokens to msg.sender as recipient.
The ICO owner address is the destination of the ETH value transfer in buyTokens.
The token state variable supplies the external contract target used by token.transferFrom in buyTokens.
buyTokens performs an external call into the token contract, which can execute arbitrary code and re-enter the sale.
buyTokens forwards ETH via owner.transfer, an external value call executed after state updates but still before the transaction completes.
The whenSaleIsActive modifier reads the icostart flag, making sale participation conditional on that state variable.
RATE feeds the multiplication computing the number of tokens to sell.
buyTokens executes weiAmount.mul(RATE), a mutation-free but overflow-sensitive arithmetic step.
raisedAmount is both read and written by the add operation inside buyTokens.
buyTokens executes raisedAmount.add(msg.value), accumulating funds with arithmetic safeguards.
balanceOf[msg.sender] is the operand that is decremented by sub(_value).
transfer performs the balance subtraction guarded by SafeMathMod.sub.
transfer performs the recipient balance addition guarded by SafeMathMod.add.
balanceOf[_to] is the operand that is incremented by add(_value).
transferFrom decrements the source balance via SafeMathMod.sub.
transferFrom increments the destination balance via SafeMathMod.add.
The allowed mapping entry is the storage slot decremented by the allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
transferFrom conditionally subtracts _value from the stored allowance.
MAX_UINT256 is the sentinel compared against the allowance before performing the subtraction.
transfer reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for both sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for _from and _to.
approve writes the allowed mapping, granting spending authority to another address.
allowance returns the value stored in the allowed mapping.
multiPartyTransfer delegates each transfer to the transfer function in a bounded loop.
multiPartyTransferFrom delegates each transfer to the transferFrom function in a bounded loop.
The icocontract payable fallback forwards all incoming ETH to buyTokens.
The whenSaleIsActive modifier gates execution of buyTokens on the icostart flag.
onlyOwner guards setToken, restricting token address changes to the owner.
onlyOwner guards setRate, restricting price changes to the owner.
onlyOwner guards setIcostart, restricting sale toggling to the owner.
setToken writes the token state variable with the supplied Usdcoins instance.
setRate writes RATE, the multiplicand used in the buyTokens token computation.
setIcostart writes the icostart flag that controls sale availability.
The Usdcoins constructor sets owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
The Usdcoins constructor credits totalSupply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
SafeMathMod.sub implements the checked balance decrement used in transfer.
SafeMathMod.add implements the checked balance increment used in transfer.
SafeMathMod.sub implements the checked balance decrement used in transferFrom.
SafeMathMod.add implements the checked balance increment used in transferFrom.
SafeMathMod.sub implements the allowance decrement used in transferFrom.
SafeMathMod.add implements the raisedAmount accumulation used in buyTokens.
SafeMathMod.mul implements the weiAmount * RATE token computation used in buyTokens.
The local weiAmount (msg.value) is the left operand of the multiplication in buyTokens.
The computed tokens local is passed as the amount argument of the external token.transferFrom call.
The _value parameter of transfer is the amount subtracted from the caller balance.
The _value parameter of transferFrom is the amount subtracted from the source balance.
The local allowance variable participates in the allowance check preceding the allowance subtraction.
The _token parameter of setToken is stored into the token state variable.
The rate parameter of setRate is stored into RATE, changing ICO arithmetic.
The newicostart parameter of setIcostart is stored into the icostart flag.
The _spender parameter of approve receives the granted allowance.
The _value parameter of approve is the allowance amount written to storage.
The _owner parameter of allowance indexes the allowed mapping read.
The _spender parameter of allowance indexes the allowed mapping read.
The _addr parameter of isNotContract is passed to extcodesize in the inline assembly block.
The _from parameter of multiPartyTransferFrom is forwarded to each transferFrom call.
